description: Live service health from ClickHouse: request volume, error rate, p95 latency and detected anomalies per microservice.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS requests FROM observability.raw_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND service IN ($service)
SELECT round(100.0 * countIf(status_code >= 500) / count(), 2) AS error_rate FROM observability.raw_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND service IN ($service)
SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(latency_ms), 1) AS p95 FROM observability.raw_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND service IN ($service)
SELECT count() AS anomalies FROM observability.anomalies WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND service IN ($service)
SELECT minute AS "time", service, error_rate FROM observability.service_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND service IN ($service) ORDER BY minute
SELECT minute AS "time", service, p95_latency_ms FROM observability.service_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND service IN ($service) ORDER BY minute
SELECT minute AS "time", service, requests FROM observability.service_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) AND service IN ($service) ORDER BY minute
SELECT timestamp, service, error_rate, z_score, requests, errors, p95_latency_ms FROM observability.anomalies ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT 50

title: Service Health - Observability Platform
